title: Shared weights, shared scenes: code and results for measuring error correlation in vision-based UAV swarm quorum decisions
description: Code, result files (JSON) and figures for the manuscript 'Shared Weights, Shared Scenes: Measuring Viewpoint, Condition and Detector Components of Error Correlation for Quorum Decisions in Vision-Based UAV Swarms' (submitted to Drones, MDPI). Includes the synthetic stimulus generator, the multi-detector runner, the tetrachoric-correlation estimator with stratum bootstrap, the Monte-Carlo simulation of quorum rules with measured kernels, and the figure generator.
